# Billing Problem Definition Note 4

The core problem is that billing handling of subscription interacts with coupon; teams noted that payout depends on discount and arrears, especially under real production load. Users repeatedly report friction because billing handling of refund interacts with writeoff; teams noted that chargeback depends on payment and ledger, especially under real production load. Left unresolved, billing handling of invoice interacts with invoiceline; teams noted that dunning depends on creditnote and currency, especially under real production load, and adoption stalls. The recurring symptom teams flag is that billing handling of renewal interacts with tax; teams noted that proration depends on settlement and gateway, especially under real production load.
